verdict.rationale: Unreal ships multiple first-party mechanisms for editor extensibility: Blueprints visual scripting, C++ gameplay class extension, a documented Python scripting API for editor automation (asset management, custom UIs, pipeline tooling), a Plugins system that explicitly extends Editor capabilities, and a Remote Control REST/WebSocket API plus Unreal Automation Tool for scripted workflows. Community commentary corroborates real-world use but also notes friction (e.g., needing C++ for tasks Blueprints can't handle), which tempers but doesn't contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on case studies specifically validating large-scale editor plugin/tool development, and no official Epic MCP/agent-facing tooling for this workflow.
